research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Cockroach Labs is researching methods and systems for non-blocking transactions, enabling efficient execution of write transactions in distributed databases, as described in 'Methods and systems for non-blocking transactions.' They are also developing systems for block properties in log-structured merge tree storage, optimizing data structure encoding and filtering. Additional work includes locality-aware query optimization and multi-region database systems, highlighting focus areas in distributed, cloud-native SQL database technology.

overview_description.description: Cockroach Labs is behind Cockroach DB, the cloud-native, distributed SQL database to modern cloud applications. It helps companies of all sizes—and the apps they develop— to scale fast, survive anything, and thrive everywhere. CockroachDB is in use at some of the world's largest enterprises across all industries, including Equifax, Bose, Comcast, and some of the largest companies in banking, retail, and media.

about_short_description.short_description: Cockroach Labs is a software company that develops a cloud-native SQL database for modern cloud applications.

product.name: CockroachDB
product.description: A distributed, PostgreSQL-compatible SQL database for cloud-native applications requiring scalable transactions, high availability, global data placement, and consistent performance.

product.name: CockroachDB Fully-Managed Cloud
product.description: A fully managed cloud database service that runs CockroachDB while Cockroach Labs manages infrastructure, operations, scaling, upgrades, backups, and resilience.

product.name: CockroachDB Bring Your Own Cloud
product.description: A deployment option that runs CockroachDB in a customer-controlled public-cloud environment while providing distributed SQL capabilities and Cockroach Labs software support.

product.name: CockroachDB Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise distribution of CockroachDB for organizations that need a commercially supported database deployment under their own operational control.

product.name: Cockroach Labs Professional Services
product.description: Advisory and implementation services that help organizations deploy, migrate to, operate, and optimize CockroachDB for modern distributed applications.

product.name: CockroachDB Technical Support
product.description: Subscription-based technical assistance for CockroachDB, including usage guidance, documentation clarification, error investigation, updates, workarounds, and fixes.
